subject.title: feat: ask_user follow-ups — harness convergence, channel finalization + reactions, native cards, docked web panel

question: What upgrade contract should grant `operator.questions` to already-paired native operators without silently widening an existing device token's authorization?
rationale: The branch adds a new operator permission and needs an intentional compatibility boundary: silently extending stored grants and requiring re-pairing have different security and user-support consequences.

options.title: Require visible reauthorization
options.body: Add an in-product re-pair or permission-refresh flow that requests the new scope and keeps the authorization expansion explicit.

options.title: Treat re-pairing as the upgrade requirement
options.body: Document that existing native pairings must be recreated before question cards are available, accepting the temporary feature gap.

options.title: Extend stored operator grants automatically
options.body: Migrate existing device-token scopes to include questions, accepting an implicit expansion of previously granted permissions.

recommendation.title: Require visible reauthorization
recommendation.body: Add an in-product re-pair or permission-refresh flow that requests the new scope and keeps the authorization expansion explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: The current and merged question-runtime history places the authorization and client-upgrade boundary with this feature owner.
